info.description: Uploads a new photo to Flickr
info.title: Flickr API Schema

requests.description: Returns an access token
requests.name: GET /oauth/access_token

requests.description: Returns an oauth token and oauth token secret
requests.name: GET /oauth/request_token

requests.description: Returns next and previous favorites for a photo in a user's favorites
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.favorites.getContext

requests.description: Returns a list of the user's favorite photos. Only photos which the calling user has permission to see are returned.
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.favorites.getList

requests.description: Returns a list of photos in a gallery.
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.galleries.getPhotos

requests.description: Get information on a group topic reply
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.groups.discuss.replies.getInfo

requests.description: Get information about a group discussion topic
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.groups.discuss.topics.getInfo

requests.description: Get a list of discussion topics in a group.
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.groups.discuss.topics.getList

requests.description: Get information about a group
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.groups.getInfo

requests.description: Returns next and previous photos for a photo in a group pool
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.groups.pools.getContext

requests.description: Returns a list of pool photos for a given group
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.groups.pools.getPhotos

requests.description: Returns a person
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.people.getInfo

requests.description: Return photos from the given user's photostream
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.people.getPhotos

requests.description: Returns next and previous photos in a photo list
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photolist.getContext

requests.description: Returns next and previous photos for a photo in a photostream
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photos.getContext

requests.description: Retrieves a list of EXIF/TIFF/GPS tags for a given photo. The calling user must have permission to view the photo.
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photos.getExif

requests.description: Returns a photo
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photos.getInfo

requests.description: Returns photo sizes
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photos.getSizes

requests.description: Fetches a list of available photo licenses for Flickr
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photos.licenses.getInfo

requests.description: Return a list of photos matching some criteria.
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photos.search

requests.description: Returns next and previous photos for a photo in a set
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photosets.getContext

requests.description: Returns the albums belonging to the specified user
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photosets.getList

requests.description: Returns a list of photos in an album.
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.photosets.getPhotos

requests.description: Echos the input parameters back in the response
requests.name: GET /rest?method=flickr.test.echo

requests.description: Uploads a new photo to Flickr
requests.name: POST /upload
requests.note: Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads
